acceptanceCriteria: render_human_outcome no longer takes a repository root path and performs no filesystem or crate-internal validation calls; it only formats an already-assembled input struct and a language code.

A new use-case function assembles the render input (OutcomeV2, the human-decision projection, and the archived-unclosed fact) by calling outcome_v2_with_runtime plus the existing close_decision_is_valid_for_status/load_human_decision logic exactly once each; that logic is not duplicated.

All four existing call sites (crates/cockpit-cli/src/main.rs WorkItemCommand::Outcome, print_lifecycle_result, emit_blocked_lifecycle_handoff; crates/cockpit-mcp/src/lib.rs work_item_outcome) are migrated to the new assemble-then-render flow.
render_human_outcome is directly unit-testable by constructing its input struct in memory, with no repository directory or filesystem required.

Behavioral parity is proven for: missing human decision, invalid/malformed human decision, valid approved human decision, an archived-but-unclosed Work Item, and a historical/superseded Work Item -- same rendered text before and after this refactor for each case.
cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, and cargo test --locked --workspace pass; CLI/MCP JSON output, exit codes, and governance semantics are unchanged.
goal: render_human_outcome becomes a pure function over a fully-assembled input struct, with a new use-case function that assembles that input (OutcomeV2 plus the human-decision projection and archived-unclosed fact) in one place; all four call sites share it; no output, JSON schema, exit code, or governance semantics changes.
intent: Purify crates/cockpit-repository/src/outcome_render.rs so it only formats already-observed, already-validated facts: render_human_outcome currently takes a repository root and, inside the render path, reads .ai/decisions/<id>.close.json (load_human_decision) and checks archive-contract existence plus close-decision validity, mixing file I/O and governance validation into what should be a pure text-formatting function. All four call sites (cli main.rs x3, mcp lib.rs x1) already call outcome_v2_with_runtime immediately before calling render_human_outcome, so the redundant read is structural, not incidental.
outOfScope: Any change to Outcome text content
or localization strings; this is a pure structural refactor
Any change to OutcomeV2's serialized JSON schema (deny_unknown_fields struct used as --json output)
Any change to close_decision_is_valid_for_status's validation rules or any other governance decision logic
